name: The REIT Play
description: Repositioning a distressed Class-B office portfolio through §1031 exchange, CMBS workout, and an UPREIT §721 roll-up — a five-round US real estate finance simulation for MBA/MSRE/MRED learners.

Partner Briefing
Round 1 of 5

Round 1 — Portfolio Triage

Eleven Class-B suburban office assets facing a maturity wall. Classify and allocate reserves.
Round outcome

Your Decisions

Round 1 decisions — triage and reserves

Handing keys back sheds debt and assets; holding everything keeps optionality and burns cash.

Share of the $18M reserve envelope you deploy now. What you do not deploy stays as dry powder.

Round 2 decisions — §1031 exchange structure

The QI holds your exchange proceeds for up to 180 days. An uninsured QI is a counterparty you cannot diversify.

Blow the identification and the whole exchange becomes a taxable sale. Flexibility costs certainty.

Round 3 decisions — CMBS workout

All four routes resolve the maturing debt. They differ in the equity they consume and what the LPs make of you afterwards.

A bad-faith filing is the one lever that can pierce the SPE and reach the sponsor personally.

Round 4 decisions — §721 UPREIT roll-up

OP units defer the gain but hand you an illiquid security priced by the sponsor.

A long lockup is what the sponsor wants. Your LPs want an exit.

Round 5 decisions — LPAC recommendation

Time lets value recover — and stretches the same multiple over more years, which lowers the annualised return.

Promote in a sub-1.0x fund is a Fund IV decision dressed up as a Fund III decision.

summary.en: At Quillmoor Capital Partners, four CMBS loans worth US$78 million on Fund III's Class-B office buildings mature within 18 months, and three no longer cover their debt service. You reposition the portfolio through a 1031 exchange, a CMBS workout and an UPREIT roll-up.
summary.es: En Quillmoor Capital Partners, cuatro préstamos CMBS por 78 millones de dólares sobre los edificios de oficinas clase B del Fund III vencen en 18 meses, y tres ya no cubren su servicio de deuda. Reposicionas la cartera con un intercambio 1031, una reestructuración CMBS y un roll-up UPREIT.

text.en: Evaluate a like-kind exchange as a trade between tax deferral captured and execution risk, showing how pool size, the intermediary as a single counterparty and the identification rule move the deferral banked
text.es: Evaluar un intercambio de inmuebles de naturaleza similar como equilibrio entre el diferimiento fiscal obtenido y el riesgo de ejecución, mostrando cómo el tamaño del lote, el intermediario como contraparte única y la regla de identificación cambian el diferimiento conseguido

text.en: Compare CMBS maturity workout routes on equity consumed, debt resolved and investor perception, and explain how a bankruptcy threat turns non-recourse debt into sponsor exposure through carve-outs
text.es: Comparar las vías de reestructuración al vencimiento de préstamos CMBS por capital consumido, deuda resuelta y percepción de los inversores, y explicar cómo una amenaza de quiebra convierte la deuda sin recurso en exposición del promotor a través de las cláusulas de excepción

text.en: Assess an UPREIT contribution against a taxable sale and a partial contribution, accounting for sponsor-set NAV, operating-partnership unit illiquidity and lockup terms
text.es: Valorar una aportación a una UPREIT frente a una venta con tributación y una aportación parcial, teniendo en cuenta el valor liquidativo fijado por el promotor, la iliquidez de las unidades de la sociedad operativa y los plazos de bloqueo

text.en: Justify a portfolio triage and reserve-deployment plan in which the capital committed matches the strategy chosen, and diagnose sunk-cost reasoning in hold decisions
text.es: Justificar un plan de priorización de la cartera y de uso de reservas en el que el capital comprometido corresponda a la estrategia elegida, y diagnosticar el razonamiento de costes hundidos en las decisiones de mantener activos

text.en: Recommend a fund-term and promote treatment for a fund below 1.0x, distinguishing annualised return from multiple and weighing current-fund GP economics against next-fund reputation
text.es: Recomendar un plazo del fondo y un tratamiento del promote para un fondo por debajo de 1,0x, distinguiendo la rentabilidad anualizada del múltiplo y sopesando la economía del GP en el fondo actual frente a su reputación para el siguiente

prerequisites.en: NOI, cap rates, DSCR and LTV, and basic capital-structure reasoning
prerequisites.es: NOI, tasas de capitalización, DSCR y LTV, y razonamiento básico sobre estructura de capital

prerequisites.en: Private-fund vocabulary: contributed capital, preferred return, promote, advisory committee
prerequisites.es: Vocabulario de fondos privados: capital aportado, rentabilidad preferente, promote y comité asesor
